title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Benefit Features: Insulin Cap, Preventive Drugs, Vaccines and Over-the-Counter Products
content:
Four benefit features of the Pharmacy Benefit Plan are set design by design: the most a member pays for a 30-day supply of a covered insulin product, zero member cost share for ACA preventive-service drugs, zero member cost share for ACIP-recommended vaccines given at a network pharmacy, and coverage of over-the-counter products on the covered OTC list when prescribed.

| Plan design | Insulin cap per 30-day supply (USD) | ACA preventive drugs at zero cost share | ACIP vaccines at a network pharmacy at zero cost share | Covered OTC products covered at tier 1 when prescribed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | 35.00 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | 35.00 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Northbridge Rx Value | 35.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Select | 25.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | 25.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | 25.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Terms of the features

1. **Insulin cap.** The insulin cap is the maximum member cost share for a 30-day supply of a covered insulin product: 35.00 on Northbridge Rx HSA Saver, Basic and Value, and 25.00 on Northbridge Rx Select, Plus and Premier.
2. **ACA preventive drugs.** ACA preventive-service drugs — for example generic contraceptives, low-dose statins for adults aged 40 to 75, and tobacco cessation products — are covered at zero member cost share on every design.
3. **Vaccines.** ACIP-recommended vaccines given at a network pharmacy are covered at zero member cost share on every design.
4. **Over-the-counter products.** Over-the-counter products on the covered OTC list are covered at tier 1 when prescribed under Northbridge Rx Value, Select, Plus and Premier. Under Northbridge Rx HSA Saver and Northbridge Rx Basic this feature is not part of the design.

## Points of comparison

- The insulin cap splits the lineup in two: 35.00 for the three lower-ranked designs and 25.00 for the three higher-ranked designs.
- ACA preventive drugs and network-pharmacy vaccines are at zero member cost share across the whole lineup; the designs differ on these four features only in the insulin cap figure and the over-the-counter feature.
